tasks.subject: Task 1: ENT errors reach the error page (#118)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every promise the ENT path drops today gets a catch that logs it and publishes `error`, so a throw on ENT shows the error page like a throw on any other key.

**Files:**
- Modify: `kln90b/controls/ErrorPage.tsx` (add `reportErrors`)
- Modify: `kln90b/pages/MainPage.tsx:539-540` (EVT_ENT)
- Modify: `kln90b/pages/FourSegmentPage.tsx:33-44` (`SixLinePage.enter`), `:109-111` (container EVT_ENT)
- Modify: `kln90b/pages/FiveSegmentPage.tsx:155-157` (container EVT_ENT)
- Modify: `kln90b/pages/WelcomePage.tsx:98-100`
- Modify: `kln90b/controls/FlightplanList.tsx:477-483`, `:490`
- Modify: `kln90b/pages/left/DirectToPage.tsx:66`
- Create: `test/render/ErrorsOnEnter.test.ts`
- Modify: `test/render/pages/right/IntPage.test.ts:640-648` (the #286 pin)
- Modify: `docs/testing.md` (section 6 trap at about line 821; section 9 "Boot, power and the unit as a whole" at about line 1440)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A throw inside an ENT handler of a half page (SET 1, the approval of the WPT waypoint) lands in `unit.errors` as an `error` event, and `unit.takeRejections()` returns `[]`.
- [ ] A throw inside an ENT handler of an overlay (the SET 0 button) does the same.
- [ ] The #286 pin also asserts `expect(unit.errors).toEqual([])` and is still an `it.fails` that fails.
- [ ] `docs/testing.md` no longer says ENT errors miss the error page; it names the deeper drops that remain (async `enterCallback`s that `Editor.enter` and `WaypointEditor.currentValueConfirmed` do not await, `onCharChanged`, the async selections of APT 7 and APT 8).

**Verify:** `npx vitest run test/render/ErrorsOnEnter.test.ts test/render/pages/right/IntPage.test.ts` → all pass (the #286 pin as expected fail)
